reference.detector: 1.1 t of tungsten, 25 x 30 x 80 cm

ally.name: ally
ally.label: Q2 > 4 GeV2, all y
ally.note: The benchmark's Q2 floor with NO y window, for the comparison against arXiv:2402.13318 Table I, which is fully inclusive in y. Used only there; the benchmark's own region is unchanged.

faser_s.name: faser_s
faser_s.label: FASER Tier S (spectrometer-like)
faser_s.note: Inclusive region plus E' > 100 GeV and theta < 25 mrad, after the spectrometer muon-appearance analyses. At 1 TeV the energy cut coincides with the y < 0.9 already imposed, so the ANGULAR cut is what acts: it removes the high-Q2, high-y corner.

faser_s_ally.name: faser_s_ally
faser_s_ally.label: Tier S muon cuts, no y window (FASER's acceptance)
faser_s_ally.note: E' > 100 GeV and theta < 25 mrad and nothing else, so that the fraction passing is comparable with Table II of arXiv:2412.03186.
